body:
Freeze recipe correction (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-23, on w-80e0). Write the review-freeze manifest under the repository's OWN git config (core.autocrlf=true on this host), with no GIT_CONFIG override:
`cd <root> && node C:/github/Personal/Engram/scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs --write <abs .git/worktrees/<wt>/manifest.json>`
then `termal.exe review-freeze-check <ABS ROOT> <ABS MANIFEST> <FP>`.
termal.exe review-freeze-check computes under the default config. A manifest written with GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.autocrlf / VALUE_0=false gives a different fingerprint whenever the root has CRLF working files, so the check says "review input drifted" (and "manifest … mismatch" if you pass the default fingerprint against the override's manifest). It only happened to match on roots whose changed files were all LF. The tree id from `git write-tree` doesn't depend on this. Also keep new files' working-copy endings consistent with checkout (CRLF here).
